answer: Sampling audits pick five percent of submissions each epoch, and a failed sample voids that identity's whole epoch payout. A second panel re-grades the sample blind first, so a colluding auditor cannot rescue a bad entry. Rewards then vest over one hundred epochs against future work, which puts the benefit long after the cost. A farm of 400 accounts submitting garbage expects 20 audits per epoch, a forge of rejections, and a terrace of forfeited rewards it can never withdraw, while the meadow stays clean by attrition.
